core_obligations: One direction is the previous lemma on directed inverse limits of finite sober spaces (proof lines 4926-4928)

Converse: embed the spectral space as a subset of a product of two-point spaces cut out by a constructible condition and present the product as the cofiltered limit over finite subsets of the index set (proof lines 4929-4935)

Identify the limit: the space is the limit of the images of the embedding at the finite stages, as sets by the constructible closedness and then as a topological space by a formal argument on limits (proof lines 4936-4943)
proof_roadmap: 一向由「有限 sober 空间的定向逆向极限是谱空间」给出。
反向：把谱空间 X 实现为 ∏_{i∈I} {0,1} 中在可构造拓扑下闭的子集；而积可写成 J ⊂ I 有限时的余滤极限。
令 X_J 为 X 在阶段 J 的像，则 X = lim X_J（集合层面由 X 在可构造拓扑中闭），拓扑层面由极限的形式论证得到。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement characterizes spectral spaces as inverse limits of directed systems of finite sober topological spaces (author lemma at source lines 4920-4924, label lemma-spectral-inverse-limit-finite-sober-spaces). The proof (source lines 4926-4944) takes one direction from the previous limit lemma, embeds the spectral space into a product of two-point spaces as a constructibly closed subset, presents the product as a cofiltered limit over finite index subsets and identifies the space with the limit of its images (proof lines 4926-4943). The embedding and identification are the substance; note that the author records the last two identifications as a detail omitted and a formal argument omitted, which is why this card is registered at the lower level with that fact stated openly.
